bifrost: springboard/proto/src/sys.rs (shm_create, SCM_RIGHTS), springboard/src/bare/wayland.rs (dma-buf wl_buffer), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (BufferInfo), springboard/src/media/mod.rs (DmaBuf trait, DmaPicture)
summary: The system layer shares buffers across processes with memfd and fd passing, and imports GPU dma-bufs with format and modifier metadata. Apps get no IOSurface-like SDK type: they receive shared memory only as internal pixel copies, with no lookup by ID, attributes, purgeability or colour space.

features.note: memfd shared memory exists in the proto layer; no app-facing SDK type wraps it

features.note: Linux fd passing over SOCK_SEQPACKET replaces Mach ports; used by the shell, not exposed to apps

gaps: No app-facing SDK type for a shared buffer: apps cannot create, lock, or share an IOSurface-like object.
No global ID registry or lookup by ID between processes.
No per-buffer attributes (key-value store, colour space, ICC profile).
No use counts, in-use query, or buffer-level purgeability.
No CPU write lock API, and no selectable cache mode.
Zero-copy frames from the engine into the window pool (dma-buf from a GPU context) are not done.
